attackers_goals: Map the cloud email environment and detect potential email resources to abuse.
description: A cloud identity attempted to discover available email sending resources within the cloud environment. This may indicate an adversary attempting to map the organization's email sending environment and discover cloud resources that may assist to send phishing emails or spam.
investigative_actions: Check the identity's role designation in the organization. Identify which available email resources were discovered. Investigate if the discovered email resources were used to send phishing emails or spam, or perform other attacks in the cloud environment.
name: Cloud email infrastructure enumeration activity
